description: Save an email as a draft instead of sending it, so a person can review, edit and approve it first (human in the loop). Nothing is sent. For a reply pass reply_to_message_id (recipients, "Re:" subject and threading are filled in; reply_all adds the other recipients). Optionally pass send_at to schedule it. Send it later with send_draft or schedule_draft. Returns the draft id.

bcc.description: One email address, or a list of addresses. "Name <addr@x.com>" is allowed.

cc.description: One email address, or a list of addresses. "Name <addr@x.com>" is allowed.

data.description: Structured data: a JSON object or array (at most 64 KB). Agentboxd recipients get it as the message's "data"; email recipients get an agentboxd-data.json attachment.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

labels.description: Labels on the draft (and on the sent message).

reply_all.description: For a reply: also include the other recipients of the original.

reply_to_message_id.description: Make it a reply to this message of the inbox.

send_at.description: ISO 8601 time to send at, at least 1 minute and at most 30 days from now, e.g. "2026-10-01T09:00:00Z".

subject.description: Subject. Omit for a reply to get "Re: <original subject>".

to.description: One email address, or a list of addresses. "Name <addr@x.com>" is allowed.

type.description: What the message is: "message" (default), "task" (asks the recipient to do something) or "event" (reports that something happened).

name: create_draft
title: Create draft
